annotations.text:
Reverse-engineered from ios/App/App/ — colours from Theme.swift, strings from the Swift literals.

The dates and fasting rules were produced by the app's own engine, not typed in: 11 September 2026 is 29 August on the church calendar, Усековање, a Friday — глас 5, сухоједење, катизме 19–20 at Matins and 18 at Vespers.
The dashed block is the design decision most worth judging: content not yet transcribed shows as a NAMED gap, so a prayer rule never looks complete when it isn't.
Set in Cormorant Garamond and EB Garamond — the faces the app intends. It currently ships system serif; bundling the real files is open work item 5.
